articles.title: Rita Süssmuth: Deutscher Bundestag würdigt Rita Süssmuth mit Trauerstaatsakt

articles.image_title: Rita Süssmuth: BERLIN, GERMANY - FEBRUARY 24: A portrait of Rita Suessmuth stands at small makeshift memorial outside the plenary hall during a state memorial ceremony at the Bundestag for former Bundestag president Rita Suessmuth on February 24, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. She was known for her clear and at times provocative expression and her dedication to issues including women's rights and migration. (Photo by Omer Messinger/Getty Images)
